mapper.select: SELECT * FROM coupons ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM coupons WHERE UPPER(code) = UPPER(#{code})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupons(code, discount_type, discount_value, max_uses, used_count, min_order_amount, starts_at, expires_at, is_active) VALUES(#{code}, #{discountType}, #{discountValue}, #{maxUses}, #{usedCount}, #{minOrderAmount}, #{startsAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{active})
mapper.update: UPDATE coupons SET code=#{code}, discount_type=#{discountType}, discount_value=#{discountValue}, max_uses=#{maxUses}, min_order_amount=#{minOrderAmount}, starts_at=#{startsAt}, expires_at=#{expiresAt}, is_active=#{active} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE coupons SET is_active=#{active} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE coupons SET used_count=used_count+1 WHERE id=#{id}
